text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It can be difficult to wrap your head around
finding the right legacies and support cards
to turn your trainees into powerhouses…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So to help trainers with that, 
I'd like to introduce a new aid 
called Career Roadmaps!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let me quickly explain how it works.
Roadmaps provide three functions.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The first is Targets. It lets you configure
the stats, skills, traits, and so on that you 
want to reach.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Next is Support. This is the functionality that 
actively helps you reach your previously set 
targets during a Career.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Finally, there's the Comparison function.
This lets you check how closely your trainee 
actually matched a Roadmap's targets.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go over this example Roadmap together 
to see things in more detail. An existing
Roadmap can be loaded using its Share ID.
